1. **@sontungmtp777** đã cập nhật trên mạng xã hội: “Are you guys still listening to COME MY WAY? SKYS, don’t forget to continue listening to the song on all platforms!” [Xem thêm](https://x.com/MTPGlobalUnion/status/2061690390491885844).

items.title: 🫍 Is San gonna pick up the call? Hello San my baby.
items.summary:
🫍 Is San gonna pick up the call? Hello San my baby.
🫍 Papa papa~
🫍 You're so famous now.
🫍 What did you say, Papa?
🫍 Here, you're everywhere, even on the cushion. How come you ended up on this cushion? Even Papa never been here before. You're way more famous than Papa. Is this the one you said won't cakey on skin? right, baby?
🫍 Yes, papa~
🫍 Papa will try using it first. Do your best at school, baby.
